title: Kronkronbea no Ho Adesrɛfo
intro: Wɔ anadwo nnɔnhwerew a ɛhɔ yɛ dinn mu no, ɔkra bi a ɔde ne ho ama frɛɛ Mmɔborohunufo no wɔ beae kronkron bi afasu kronkron no mu. Na wɔde anwonwade a ɛde anigye ne nkɔmhyɛ agyapade bɛbrɛ mfe pii gyidi ne boasetɔ a enhinhim no akatua.
clues: Mede me awia ne anadwo dii ahofama mu wɔ kronkronbea kronkron bi mu, na mesrɛɛ m’Awurade bere nyinaa.
Mebɔɔ akwakoraa, na me yere yɛ obonin, nanso manhwere anidasoɔ wɔ Allah mmɔborɔhunu mu da.
Wɔmaa me ɔbabarima, a wɔfrɛ no Yahya, a ɔbɛyɛɛ odiyifoɔ ne trenee kanea.
Na m’ankasa meyɛ odiyifo, a wɔsomaa me sɛ menkɔkyerɛ Israel Mma kwan.
Na meyɛ Nkɔnhyɛnyi Harun aseni na mesom sɛ ɔsɔfo wɔ Asɔredan mu.
Wɔhyɛɛ me nsa sɛ menhwɛ Maryam, Isa maame, na mihuu n’anwonwade ahorow no.

verse: And Zechariah and John and Jesus and Elias - and all were of the righteous. (6:85)
